name: Commercial Meat Cooking Temperature Chart
secondary_keywords: uk fsa meat cooking temperature guide
search_intent: Professional chefs, caterers, and culinary students seeking a master commercial meat cooking chart providing internal core temperatures, cook times per kilogram, resting carry-over rise, and probe protocols across all culinary meats (beef, lamb, pork, poultry, duck, venison, fish).

competitors.title: Cooking Your Food Safely | Food Standards Agency
competitors.weaknesses: Static text page mentioning only the broad 70°C for 2m / 75°C rule without species-specific cut breakdowns or rest calculations.

competitors.title: Chef-Recommended Meat Temperature Chart | ThermoWorks
competitors.strengths: Attractive visual design and probe marketing.
competitors.weaknesses: US Fahrenheit focus, static graphics, no interactive weight-to-time roast calculator.

competitors.title: Safe Cooking Temperatures & Time Limits | High Speed Training
competitors.strengths: Good explanation of pathogen kill times.
competitors.weaknesses: Static table, no interactive joint weight scaling or printable commercial kitchen charts.

competitors.title: Meat Cooking Times & Temperatures | BBC Good Food
competitors.strengths: High search volume consumer recipe portal.
competitors.weaknesses: Domestic recipes, lacks commercial kitchen CCP protocols, Scotland 82°C standards, and EHO audit trails.

competitors.title: Internal Meat Temperature Chart | WebstaurantStore
competitors.weaknesses: US FDA Food Code standards, lacks UK FSA regulatory alignment and interactive controls.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Static reference tables or domestic recipe advice.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An interactive digital master meat calculator supporting multiple species, weight-based time estimates, dual UK/Scotland regulatory limits, and probe placement guides.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Interactive species switcher covering British Beef, Poultry, Lamb, Pork, Duck, Venison, Ham, Fish, Burgers, and Turkey with real-time roast calculator and one-click printable A4 kitchen chart.
